python3 - << 'PY'
import workcell, statistics

def avg_locate(name, n=2):
    xs, ys = [], []
    for _ in range(n):
        d = workcell.call("robot", "locate", name).data
        if "x" not in d:
            print("NO DATA", name, d)
            continue
        xs.append(float(d["x"])); ys.append(float(d["y"]))
    return statistics.mean(xs), statistics.mean(ys)

# correct K2
kx, ky = avg_locate("K2", 2)
mx, my = avg_locate("M2", 2)
dx, dy = kx-mx, ky-my
print(f"K2 offset {dx:.3f} {dy:.3f}")
r = workcell.call("robot", "nudge", "K2", f"{-dx:.3f}", f"{-dy:.3f}")
print("nudge K2", r.text, r.ok)

# place K3, K4, K6 at measured marker centres (skip K5 until we see clamp issue)
for k, m in [("K3","M3"), ("K4","M4"), ("K6","M6")]:
    mx, my = avg_locate(m, 2)
    print(f"{m} {mx:.3f} {my:.3f}")
    r = workcell.call("robot", "pick", k)
    print("pick", k, r.text, r.ok)
    if not r.ok:
        continue
    r = workcell.call("robot", "place", f"{mx:.3f}", f"{my:.3f}")
    print("place", r.text, r.ok)
    kx, ky = avg_locate(k, 2)
    mx, my = avg_locate(m, 2)
    dx, dy = kx-mx, ky-my
    print(f"{k} offset {dx:.3f} {dy:.3f}")
    r = workcell.call("robot", "nudge", k, f"{-dx:.3f}", f"{-dy:.3f}")
    print("nudge", r.text, r.ok)

print("--- verify ---")
for k, m in [("K1","M1"),("K2","M2"),("K3","M3"),("K4","M4"),("K6","M6")]:
    kx, ky = avg_locate(k, 2)
    mx, my = avg_locate(m, 2)
    dx, dy = kx-mx, ky-my
    mag = (dx*dx+dy*dy)**0.5
    print(f"{k}/{m} dx={dx:.3f} dy={dy:.3f} mag={mag:.3f}")
PY

args.command:
python3 - << 'PY'
import workcell, statistics

def avg_locate(name, n=2):
    xs, ys = [], []
    texts = []
    for _ in range(n):
        r = workcell.call("robot", "locate", name)
        texts.append(r.text)
        d = r.data
        if "x" in d:
            xs.append(float(d["x"])); ys.append(float(d["y"]))
    print(name, texts[-1])
    if not xs:
        return None
    return statistics.mean(xs), statistics.mean(ys)

m = avg_locate("M5", 2)
print("avg", m)
r = workcell.call("robot", "pick", "K5")
print("pick", r.text, r.ok)
r = workcell.call("robot", "place", f"{m[0]:.3f}", f"{m[1]:.3f}")
print("place", r.text, r.ok, r.data)
r = workcell.call("robot", "locate", "K5")
print("K5", r.text, r.data)
r = workcell.call("robot", "locate", "C2")
print("C2", r.text)
PY
